verdict.rationale: OpenCode's docs say you can use any LLM provider by configuring that provider's API keys, across 75+ providers including local models. Account logins such as GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT Plus/Pro are offered as alternatives, not requirements, and community users report running it with their own providers and local models. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the API-key setup flow (e.g., CLI auth command, environment variables, credential storage), independent hands-on confirmation of key-based auth specifically.
